subjects.name: Applied Physics
subjects.objective: To prepare the students to have a basic knowledge of fundamental quantities, their units and measurement. To study various cases under laws of motion. To have knowledge of various properties of maters also to have knowledge of fundamentals of electricity and magnetism and to have knowledge about Light and Sound Waves.
course_outcomes: To measure dimensions of various materials and compare units.
To understand and relate phenomena with the help of laws of motion.
To identify various states of materials and their relevance.
To understand the concept of Electricity and Magnetism and its application in daily life.
To get Knowledge about Light and Sound Waves and their applications.
